validate.description: Tera assertions evaluated with the module's resolved arguments. Every assertion must pass.

assert.description: Tera condition expression that must be true. References must name declared arguments.

message.description: Message reported when the assertion is false.

path.description: Required module path, relative to the declaring module file.

when.description: Optional Tera condition expression evaluated with this module's resolved arguments. Use `arg is defined` to test whether an argument was supplied. Omit for an unconditional requirement.

requires.description: Modules that must be included earlier in any output using this module. Every entry requires path, resolved relative to this module file. An optional when expression makes a requirement conditional.

path.description: File destination, relative to the yard directory. Remote sources are resolved relative to the module file.

when.description: Optional Tera condition evaluated with the module's resolved arguments. Omit to always include the file when the module is used.

files.description: Files to pull in when this module is used. Each entry requires path and optionally when. Paths are relative to the yard directory and cannot contain ~ or .. components.
